author: KEXP
description: Swedish singer-songwriter Jonathan Hultén draws influence from blues, film scores, illustrators, and an extended deal of art to create what he describes as "Ambient-Dream-grunge." Live on KEXP with host Tanner Ellison, he shares a performance of "Where The Devil Weeps" and more.
title: Jonathan Hultén performs "Where The Devil Weeps" & more Live on KEXP
